Debit freeze declines all new transactions and recurring payments, but already-authorized pending transactions may still process. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]
Freezing does not block ATM access if the customer has their PIN; ATM Block must be enabled separately through the mobile app. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Closed debit cards cannot be reactivated; the customer must order a replacement. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Escalate to the security team when a bank-initiated fraud alert is present, the customer cannot verify identity, the customer reports transactions they did not make, or the activity explanation is suspicious. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]

[doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Debit card freeze is a temporary lock; CLOSE is permanent deactivation and is the recommended action when the card is confirmed lost or stolen ('If customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, recommend closing instead of freezing'). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Customers can unfreeze a debit card themselves through the mobile app at any time; freezing does not block ATM access if the customer has the PIN — ATM access must be blocked separately via the 'ATM Block' mobile app setting. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Cards reported as lost or stolen are closed immediately with no cooling-off period; the closure tool is close_debit_card_4721 with parameters card_id and reason, and closed cards cannot be reopened. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Closing a debit card requires the card to be in ACTIVE or PENDING status and normally requires a minimum card age of 14 days, but the reasons 'lost', 'stolen', and 'fraud_suspected' bypass the minimum card age requirement for security purposes. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

There is no documented credit-card freeze/lock tool; the only documented credit-card security action for a stolen card is ordering a replacement via order_replacement_credit_card_7291, after which 'The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.' [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

For a stolen credit card, the KB strongly recommends expedited shipping (2-3 business days) to minimize exposure and reminds the customer to review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges in the app or website. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The lost/stolen cross-product protocol is agent-driven, not self-service: after completing the debit card freeze/close procedure, the agent must check credit cards with get_credit_card_accounts_by_user and proactively offer to order a replacement credit card with a new number. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

Stolen debit cards cannot be reactivated; enhanced verification (full name, date of birth, last 4 of SSN, plus 2-3 recent transaction confirmations) is required for CODE 43 stolen-card handling, and if the customer insists they never reported it stolen the agent must use transfer_to_human_agents. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

The documented user-callable (self-service) tools in the KB are narrow and card-lock is not among them: refresh_cache() (no parameters) for site/app cache issues, get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id: str), get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str), and submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str). [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002]

Escalation guidance for app/site problems: have the user run refresh_cache(), verify device/browser/app version, capture screenshots/timestamps, and escalate with logs if errors persist; security concerns such as suspected unauthorized access or account access lockouts warrant escalation. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002]

If a linked checking account's status is not OPEN, card transactions are blocked and the customer must be directed to a branch or the dedicated account services line 1-800-RHO-ACCT rather than being given account-specific details for SUSPENDED/RESTRICTED status. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_003]

A bank-initiated fraud alert (fraud_alert_active TRUE with alert_source 'bank_initiated') must not be cleared by the agent; the customer must be transferred to the security team via transfer_to_human_agents. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_003]

Debit cards can only be ordered for checking accounts (savings accounts are not eligible), and a customer cannot have more than 1 active debit card per checking account; the ordering tool is order_debit_card_5739. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Replacement-history checks are per account: retrieve all cards for the account and count cards with issue_reason 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud', or 'damaged' issued in the last 12 months against the tier limit. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

Green Fee-Free Account is an ENTRY-tier checking class while Blue Account and Green Account are MID-tier checking classes, which determines replacement limits, waiting periods, and shipping/design fees. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_005]

ENTRY tier allows a maximum of 2 replacement cards per rolling 12 months, imposes a 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered, and offers standard shipping only (delivery_fee $0); exceeding the limit requires waiting or a $25 excess replacement fee. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

MID tier allows a maximum of 3 replacement cards per rolling 12 months, has no waiting period (replacement can be ordered immediately after closure), and offers standard shipping ($0) or expedited shipping ($15); exceeding the limit requires waiting or a $15 excess replacement fee. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

All applicable replacement fees (shipping, design, excess replacement) are automatically charged to the linked checking account when the card is ordered, and the agent must provide the exact delivery_fee and design_fee amounts when calling order_debit_card_5739. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

No tool retrieves debit cards by user_id; the user_id-keyed lookup tool is get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, which returns accounts (account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, date_opened) rather than cards. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

Emergency replacement while traveling is agent/contact-us driven ('Contact us immediately to report the card as lost or stolen'), and the card is blocked as soon as it is reported. [doc_checking_accounts_purple_account_007]

facts_found: get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is the KB's designated tool for retrieving a customer's bank accounts (checkings and savings) and requires the customer's user_id; it returns account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, and date_opened. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

No other tool in the KB is documented as accepting user_id to return bank/checking account IDs; searches for an alternative account-listing tool returned only get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 requires account_id (the checking account ID) as its only parameter, so it cannot be used to discover account IDs; it returns account_id and user_id as output fields, not as lookup keys. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]
get_bank_account_transactions_9173 is keyed by account_id (not user_id), so it cannot be used to enumerate a customer's checking accounts. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

The KB documents no account_id format, prefix, or derivation rule from user_id; account IDs are treated as opaque values returned by get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 or by open_bank_account_4821. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_004]

open_bank_account_4821 returns a new account record and instructs the agent to capture the new account_id, confirming account IDs are system-assigned and retrieved rather than constructed. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_004]

The KB documents no error-handling or recovery procedure specific to a duplicate-query notice from get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847; the article contains no troubleshooting section at all. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

For a user_id-keyed lookup tool, the KB's documented troubleshooting pattern is: for partial or truncated data, retry the call; if the issue persists, capture the request context and escalate through internal support channels; for invalid or malformed user_id, validate the format of user_id and reissue the request. The KB advises ensuring the correct and current user_id is used before calling a user_id-keyed lookup tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

For site/app data issues, the user-callable tool refresh_cache() (no parameters) should be provided to the user directly to clear cached site data; the agent must not execute it on their behalf. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002]

Escalate when the issue persists across devices and networks after refresh_cache() and re-sign-in, when the customer reports specific error codes or repeated failures, or when there are security concerns or account access lockouts. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002]

Internal agent tools that require unlocking must be enabled with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then executed with call_discoverable_agent_tool; the KB does not state that get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 requires this unlock step. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_009]

facts_found: get_bank_account_transactions_9173 is keyed by account_id (not user_id), so it cannot be used to enumerate a customer's checking accounts. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

The KB documents no account_id format, prefix, or derivation rule from user_id; account IDs are treated as opaque values returned by get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 or by open_bank_account_4821. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_004]

The KB documents no error-handling or recovery procedure specific to a duplicate-query notice from get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847; the article contains no troubleshooting section at all. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

For a user_id-keyed lookup tool, the KB's documented troubleshooting pattern is: for partial or truncated data, retry the call; if the issue persists, capture the request context and escalate through internal support channels; for invalid or malformed user_id, validate the format of user_id and reissue the request. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]
The KB advises ensuring the correct and current user_id is used before calling a user_id-keyed lookup tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

For site/app data issues, the user-callable tool refresh_cache() (no parameters) should be provided to the user directly to clear cached site data; the agent must not execute it on their behalf. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002]

Escalate when the issue persists across devices and networks after refresh_cache() and re-sign-in, when the customer reports specific error codes or repeated failures, or when there are security concerns or account access lockouts. [doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002]

Internal agent tools that require unlocking must be enabled with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then executed with call_discoverable_agent_tool; the KB does not state that get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 requires this unlock step. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_009]

Debit cards exist only for checking accounts (savings accounts do not have debit cards), so the account_id values needed for get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 must be filtered to account_type checking from the account list. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

No bulk or relationship-wide stolen-card emergency tool is documented; card security actions operate on a single card_id (close_debit_card_4721) or a single credit-card account (order_replacement_credit_card_7291). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]
